name: lm-eval Native Backend Example
goal: Run lm-evaluation-harness using its native model backend while DataOS records the frozen protocol and EvalArtifact.
input_description: A ModelArtifact. lm-eval fetches task data and owns model inference through the configured backend.
output_description: A single EvalArtifact containing results.json, protocol.json, lm_eval_results.json, and optional samples files.
